## @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.5.1

A focused follow-up to 0.5.0 that fixes source-dialog notification coloring on the DSH version currently used by the plugin and makes recurring reminders explicit in the control center.

### Fixed

- The built-in alarm/clock mark on the source Session now follows the same unread state as the global Schedule entry.
- DSH 0.1.7-rc.1's trailing `ActiveScheduleIndicator` is supported directly.
- The newer leading Schedule mark shape remains supported.
- Session-list key, `sessionId`, and `id` aliases are all considered when matching a reminder back to its source dialog.
- Unread overdue reminders retain warning-color priority.
- Opening Schedule returns seen source-session marks to the native gray state.

### Added

- Recurring reminders now show an explicit **Recurring** tag.
- The Recurring filter and notification summary use the same recurrence predicate.
- The recurrence predicate covers `every`, `daily`, `weekly`, and `cron` record kinds; DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 continues to expose its supported recurring form.

### Verification

- `npm run test:all`
- DSH install smoke: `0.1.5-rc.3`
- DSH install smoke: `0.1.7-rc.1`
